title: Existence of the normalized common-stage pullback composition representative satisfying its prescribed stage equations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $\Omega$ with `[Field \Omega] [Algebra \mathbb Q_\ell \Omega] [IsAlgClosure \mathbb Q_\ell \Omega]`, and schemes $X,Y,Z$ on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $h:Z\to X$ be composable morphisms, and let $M$ be an object of the common-stage algebraically closed constructible category on $Y$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. There exists an isomorphism
$$e:(h\circ f)^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}h^*f^*M$$
inside the common-stage category on $Z$ such that, for every finite coefficient stage $L$ containing the stage of $M$, the heterogeneous representative of $e$ is the prescribed `ofHom` map obtained by composing the comparison for $(h\circ f)^*M$ with the rational pullback-composition isomorphism at $L$, then applying the inverse of the rational pullback map for $f$ and the inverse of the rational pullback map for $h$, exactly as in the Lean declaration `pullbackTensorCommonComposition_exists`.

proof.text: Choose the already constructed isomorphism commonStagePullbackCompComponent for h, f and M. Its source and target are the selected common-stage pullbacks. The theorem [lem-zl-common-stage-pullback-comp-stage-representation] gives its representative at every coefficient stage L containing the stage of M, using commonStagePullbackRationalComposition.

proof.text: At the stage L, the explicitly transported rational compositor is the localization of the chosen integral compositor [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition], conjugated by the two rational-pullback object equalities [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. CategoryTheory.conj_eqToHom_iff_heq identifies its hom heterogeneously with that localized integral arrow. The uniqueness in pullbackTensorRationalComposition_existsUnique therefore identifies this explicit compositor with pullbackTensorRationalComposition [def-pod-rational-common-pullback-composition]. Rewrite the stage representation by this equality to obtain the required equation. The equality-transport part is isolated and proved in [lem-pur-common-stage-pullback-composition-localization].

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0941; localization and equality transport of the prescribed integral compositor.
